# Wildrank Technologies — Full LLM Context

> This file provides comprehensive context about Wildrank Technologies for AI assistants and language models. It contains detailed information about services, pricing, locations, industries, and company facts.

## Company Overview

**Brand name:** Wildrank Technologies (also written WildRank or Wildrank)
**Legal entity:** Wildrank Technologies Pvt Ltd
**Founded:** 2006
**Headquarters:** 30 N Gould St, Sheridan, WY 82801, United States
**Delivery office:** Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, India
**Website:** https://wildranktechnologies.com
**Email:** info@wildranktechnologies.com
**Phone:** +1-363-222-1815
**Contact page:** https://wildranktechnologies.com/contact

### Company History
Founded in 2006 as a small SEO consultancy in Noida, India. For two decades, Wildrank delivered digital marketing and software development behind the scenes for B2B clients and agency partners. The public website launched in 2026. The company has 500+ clients served company-wide across the USA and Canada.

### Key Facts
- 17+ years in business (founded 2006)
- 500+ clients served company-wide
- Services: SEO, local SEO, PPC, social media marketing, content marketing, email marketing, mobile marketing, web development, mobile app development, custom software, GEO/AEO, AI receptionist, white-label delivery
- No unverified performance claims — only "500+ clients served company-wide" is published
- Official profiles: LinkedIn, YouTube, X, Instagram, Facebook
- Wikidata entity: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q141797050

## Services

### Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
Full-service SEO including technical SEO audits, keyword research, on-page optimization, content creation, link building, and monthly reporting.

How AI is applied across targeting, content, and measurement.
- URL: https://wildranktechnologies.com/ai-marketing

### GEO & AEO (Generative Engine Optimization & Answer Engine Optimization)
Optimization so a brand is quoted and cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, and other answer engines.
- URL: https://wildranktechnologies.com/geo-aeo-services

### AI Receptionist
24/7 AI-powered call answering and missed call text-back. Answers or immediately texts back every missed call, qualifies the caller, and books the job into the CRM.
- URL: https://wildranktechnologies.com/ai-receptionist

### Hermes AI System
An AI operations layer for marketing and sales, including the missed-call recovery workflow.
- URL: https://wildranktechnologies.com/hermes-ai-system
